# PRD-AI-01

**Do the gating evals pass on the release candidate?**

| | |
|---|---|
| Lens | [Production entry lens](production.md) 0.1.1 |
| Area | AI: Model and agent readiness |
| Default severity | blocker |
| Decided by | A tool, by its rule |
| Applies when | profiles include ai-solution |
| Reads | `elements.ai.evals`, `evidence.type`, `evidence.covers`, `evidence.outcome` |

## Rule

For every eval with gating true, evidence has an eval-report for this version whose covers includes the eval and whose outcome is passed.

- NIST AI 600-1, Generative AI Profile (2024) (`nist-ai-600-1`)
